## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the device-specific reason for it.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran git diff --check
- [ ] Ran relevant script or build checks
- [ ] Verified the Recovery image remains within the 32 MiB partition budget
- [ ] Tested on hardware, or clearly marked hardware validation as pending

## Risk and rollback

Describe the affected partition, expected failure mode, and rollback path.

## Evidence

Link sanitized logs, screenshots, workflow runs, or test notes. Do not include
private data, serial numbers, keys, or proprietary firmware dumps.
